chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a lone heartbeat bass in the dark, two soft footstep kicks, a cold string chord breathing in}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
deep cave dungeon before the final ascent
low triangle bass pulsing like a slow heartbeat
soft muffled kick like footsteps in a tunnel
lone pulse-wave lead with a faltering melody
high glassy bells like starlight falling from far above
